title: Resolve capture output paths before launching runtime processes
body: Failed command: bash /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh --agent minebeam --resource test --label minebeam-windowed-captures -- env -u DISPLAY -u VK_ICD_FILENAMES -u VK_LAYER_PATH -u VK_DRIVER_FILES -u VK_INSTANCE_LAYERS -u VK_LAYER_SETTINGS_PATH bash tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh build/wsl/binaries VIXEN build/wsl/binaries vixen_editor .tmp/minebeam-captures-after; it exited 1 because the helper creates the relative directory in the caller cwd but the runtime writes after changing to the binary directory. Workaround: the same helper with output directory /home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/minebeam/.tmp/minebeam-captures-final-2; it wrote all seven images and passed byte comparison. Canonicalize capture_root once before mkdir and before exporting HUD/editor capture paths.
